run_f_gold: run f_gold to compute the sum of squares of binomial coefficients for a given n
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using the built-in test harness with 10 parameter sets
create_pascal_triangle: create a Pascal triangle 2D array using dynamic programming to compute binomial coefficients up to n
sum_binomial_squares: sum the squares of all binomial coefficients in the nth row of Pascal triangle
refactor_f_filled: refactor the TOFILL placeholder f_filled to replicate the f_gold binomial coefficient sum logic
